items.briefing:
New research from Commvault finds that one in three organisations across Australia and New Zealand are still paying ransomware demands, despite this rarely guaranteeing data recovery. This is a concerning trend, especially as a cyberattack on global logistics firm Ceva has begun spreading across its supply chain partners — a reminder that your organisation can be affected even when the initial breach happens elsewhere.

If your work involves third-party suppliers or logistics providers, be cautious of unexpected emails or system access requests from those partners this week. **Practical tip:** Never pay a ransom without first consulting your IT or security team — and ensure your backups are tested and stored offline.

featured.title: Ceva cyber attack spreads across supply chain firms
featured.quote: Major supply chain disruption from Ceva cyber attack directly impacts Australian retailers and logistics.
